name: 1.23.0-beta.6
notes: Ren'Py games: “Show the saves” on a game's page lists its saves, each with its picture, name and date. Delete one with the bin button; Undo brings it back.
Importing saves can be undone: the message after an import has Undo, which puts the saves back as they were.

“Export saves” gives a ZIP of the game's saves laid out like Ren'Py's own save folder, to keep as a copy or put back on a computer. The app's save keys are left out of it, so they can never replace a computer's own.
